blocks.text: Welcome to the Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba In Flin Flon. Thank you for your interest in our organization. Being a foundation of excellence in delivering addiction services and promoting healthy behaviors, AFM is a Crown agency committed to its mission. A total of 400 people work at AFM, which operates in 28 locations throughout Manitoba and provides a variety of addictions services.

centre.about_html:
About Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba In Flin Flon

Welcome to the Addictions Foundation Of Manitoba In Flin Flon. Thank you for your interest in our organization. Being a foundation of excellence in delivering addiction services and promoting healthy behaviors, AFM is a Crown agency committed to its mission. A total of 400 people work at AFM, which operates in 28 locations throughout Manitoba and provides a variety of addictions services.

During their lifetime, at least 1 in 5 Canadians had difficulties with alcohol, medications, or gambling. When a person they love has these problems, it affects them in a big way. These problems affect people of all ages and ethnicities, and they make positive improvements.

AFM offers hope, support and change for people who are struggling with addictions.

Our addiction services include: rehabilitation, counselling and therapy, group programs, family support, peer support groups and more. We also provide resources such as information on addiction treatments available in Manitoba and how to get help.

Services include:

  • Adult Intake
  • Assessment and Referral
  • Adult Community-Primarily based Rehabilitation
  • Youth Community-Primarily based Rehabilitation
  • Youth School-Based mostly Services
  • Family Services
  • Impaired Drivers Assessments and Prevention Activities

Specialties

  • 12 Step Programs
  • Substance Abuse Treatmental

Amenities

  • 12 Step Programs
  • Substance Abuse Treatmental

Therapies

  • Holistic Therapy
  • Evidence-Based Practices
  • Yoga & Meditation
  • Individual Therapy & Counseling
  • Family Therapy & Counseling
  • Group Therapy & Counseling
  • Nutritional Counseling
  • Art & Nature Therapy
